note.headline: A productive week: 13 versions of Jarvis shipped, 20 events banked, and 256 calls made by people.
note.summary: Work went in on the code all week: 43 commits changed 82,908 lines across 101 files. The most recent changes: StrataScope Beta: Consult; Root Canal: bank by label (Project Evolve, phase 1); Support panels: a lab default, and a copy shows at once. The data grew alongside it, and every call in the curation sets is kept with who made it.
